decisions.decision: The minutes of the July 27, 2017 meeting were accepted (no motion or count recorded).
decisions.quote: minutes of the july 27, 2017, meeting were accepted.

decisions.decision: The likely target for Community Compact Grant funds was determined to be mapping catchments and critical outfalls, prioritized into 3 groups; the highest-priority group is done first.
decisions.quote: the likely target for these funds was determined to be mapping catchments and critical outfalls,

decisions.decision: Mike Clark of DCI and Ed Himlan of MWC are to provide an estimated cost at a September SWTF meeting.
decisions.quote: mike clark of design consultants, inc. (dci) and ed himlan of mwc will provide an estimated cost at a september

decisions.decision: Procedures for removing illicit discharges are to be identified and documented by Adam Burney using the CMRSWC template, then taken to DPW for adoption.
decisions.quote: procedures for removing illicit discharges to stormwater system will be identified and documented by adam burney

decisions.decision: Survey creation is put off for the moment, as it is a requirement of the new MS4 Permit likely beginning in 2018; public outreach and educational materials should begin to be addressed.
decisions.quote: it was determined that the swtf will put survey creation off for the moment as it is a requirement of the new ms4 permit

decisions.decision: Record keeping and reporting for the 2003 MS4 permit was not addressed because the DPW Director was absent.
decisions.quote: in dpw director rodriquenz' absence, this item was not addressed at this time.

decisions.decision: The website project is on hold for the moment.
decisions.quote: the s wtf has put this on hold for the moment.

decisions.decision: The Lake Shirley and Hickory Hills sediment and pollutant project is put on hold by the SWTF in favor of higher-priority MS4-related tasks.
decisions.quote: for the moment, this worthwhile plan will be put on hold by the swtf

decisions.decision: The SWTF asked the chair to contact DPW Director Rodriquenz about the MRPC data application, and the item will be placed on the next meeting agenda.
decisions.quote: the swtf asked the chair to reach out to him with this information. the task force will put it on the agenda for the next meeting.

decisions.decision: The presentation of the 2018 MS4 Permit NOI will be discussed further at a September meeting; Adam Burney is working with Town Manager Lemieux so participating boards are notified beforehand.
decisions.quote: the presentation will be discussed further at a september meeting.

decisions.decision: The IDDE Zoning bylaw and the Stormwater bylaw are to be put on the Fall Town Meeting Warrant to move them out of Zoning and into the General Bylaws.
decisions.quote: the illicit discharge detection and elimination (idde) zoning bylaw as well as the stormwater bylaw will be put on the fall town meeting warrant

decisions.decision: The meeting schedule for the rest of the third quarter and the fourth quarter was confirmed, with meetings held at 6:30 pm in the Ritter Building upper conference room unless otherwise noted.
decisions.quote: the meeting schedule was then confirmed for the remainder of the third quarter: september
